info.description:
# Traveling Safer API v1

Base URL variable `{{base_url}}` is **host only** (e.g. `http://localhost:8000`).
All paths are `{{base_url}}/api/v1/...`.

## Auth
| Variable | Use |
|----------|-----|
| `customer_token` | Customer Sanctum bearer |
| `admin_token` | Admin Sanctum bearer (+ CheckPermission) |

## Flow (assisted fulfillment)
1. Customer login → `customer_token`
2. Flight/hotel search → `search_id` / `result_id`
3. Checkout initiate → `booking_reference` + payment_url
4. Payment callback/webhook → PAID + fulfillment request
5. Admin fulfillment execute → final confirmation
6. Poll `GET /customer/bookings/{reference}/status`

## Legacy
`POST /flights/book` and `POST /hotels/book` return **410 Gone**.

Regenerated by `php scripts/rebuild_postman.php` from live Laravel route metadata.
